ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that $AB$ is the diameter of $\odot O$, with $AB=6$, and $\sin C= \frac{1}{3}$. Find the length of the chord $AD$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Draw line BD, \\
$\therefore \angle C=\angle B$, \\
$\therefore \sin B= \frac{1}{3}$, \\
$\because$ AB is the diameter, \\
$\therefore \angle ADB=90^\circ$, \\
$\therefore \sin B =\frac{AD}{AB}=\frac{1}{3}$, \\
$\therefore AD=\boxed{2}$.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: A and B are opposite endpoints of the horizontal diameter of the circle with center O, D is another point on the circle, and C is a point on the circle joined to A and D, so angle C means the inscribed angle ∠ACD subtending chord AD.
